text: answer[matrixstream-a066961d]: The task specifies a video deliverable with the following requirements: duration no longer than 30 minutes, encoded in MP4 or WebM format, and resolution of 1080p (1920x1080) or higher. A valid deliverable must satisfy all three constraints simultaneously. For MP4, use H.264 or H.265 (HEVC) codec with AAC audio at a bitrate appropriate for the resolution. For WebM, use VP9 or AV1 video with Vorbis or Opus audio. Ensure the video container's actual duration (via ffprobe) does not exceed 30:00, the frame dimensions are at least 1920 by 1080, and the file extension matches one of the two accepted formats.
